title: Masala Dosa
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

        dosa

        urad dal 

        methi 

        chana dal

        salt

        How to prepare :
        Soak above ingredients for 6 hour and grind them and ferment overnight 
        For masala: we need 3 potato, 1 onion , green chilli, in a pan add some oil and tampering items and boiled and mashed  potato, and add 
        water and salt give good mix and adjust the consistency serve with dosa.
